terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.intro: These terms govern orders placed on the DOSSORA store.

sections.p: A customer account is required to order. The order is recorded once the summary is confirmed and is confirmed after payment validation.
Prices are shown in the store currency. Shipping fees depend on the chosen country and city and are displayed before you confirm.
Stock is reserved for 24 h after ordering. Without payment within this time, the order is cancelled and stock released.
See the “Return policy” page.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We handle your data with care and only to manage your account and orders.

sections.p: Identity, email, phone, delivery addresses, order history and messages exchanged with us.
Order processing and delivery, customer service, account security. We do not sell your data.
You may access, correct or request deletion of your data by writing to us.
Payment proofs are stored in a private space accessible only to you and the DOSSORA team.
DOSSORA. Company name, address and legal identifiers (tax and trade register numbers) must be completed by the operator before going live.
Email: dossorashop@gmail.com — WhatsApp: +212 603 391 255.
The site is hosted on Cloudflare Pages; data is managed by Supabase.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: The site only uses technical storage.

sections.p: We keep your language, cart, favorites and login session in your browser.
No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are set by default.
You can clear this data from your browser settings.

returns.title: Return policy
returns.intro: Returns are possible within 48 h of receipt.

sections.p: Returns are accepted within 48 hours of receiving the parcel, only if the item is defective or the color received differs from the order.
From “My account > My orders”, open the delivered order and click “Request a return” with photos or video.
Our team reviews the request and offers an exchange or refund depending on the case.

shipping.title: Shipping policy
shipping.intro: We deliver to the countries offered at checkout.

sections.p: Fees depend on the country and city. Free delivery may apply above a purchase threshold shown at checkout.
The estimated time is shown at the delivery step. It starts after payment validation.
Your order status is visible in your account, with a notification at each step.
CIH Bank, Wafacash, Western Union, MoneyGram, Wave, bank transfer and cash on delivery (Morocco only).
Offline payments stay “pending” until our team verifies your proof.
Stock is reserved for 24 h. Without payment within this time, the order is cancelled.
